t: Signature Wireshark: What Wireshark Is: The Network's Microscope
title: Signature Wireshark: What Wireshark Is: The Network's Microscope
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigScope auditor, Manon's original packet-analysis design. SigScope mirrors the capture-dissect-filter pipeline but every capture carries a case record — whose network, under what authority, retained how long. The Signature design makes the authority part of the capture file: you inspect traffic you are entitled to inspect.

demo.code:
console.log('Wireshark: capture -> dissect -> filter');
['live capture','pcap files','3000+ dissectors','display filters','follow stream'].forEach(function(s){console.log(' '+s);});
